title: How can we help?
lead: Short step-by-step guides for planners, guests and businesses. Buttons are named exactly as they appear in the app.

search.label: Search help
search.hint: Type a word or two, for example “budget”, “link expired” or “code”. Results appear as you type.
search.emptyBody: Try a simpler word, or clear the search and pick a section from the list.

start.title: Start here
start.intro: First steps: how EventDesk works, how to sign in and how to create your first occasion.

plan.title: Plan an occasion
plan.intro: Tasks, team, date and everything that keeps the plan current.

guests.title: Guests and replies
guests.intro: The households you invite, their links and what they answer.

money.title: Money
money.intro: Budget, expenses and shared costs. Only people with finance access see them.

suppliers.title: Suppliers and the event day
suppliers.intro: From the first enquiry to the guests arriving.

space.title: Room, tables and stationery
space.intro: The room plan to scale, the seating and the invitations.

travel.title: Trips
travel.intro: For journeys: legs, groups, transport and rooms.

invited.title: For guests
invited.intro: Received an invitation link? Here is what it is and how to answer.

business.title: For businesses
business.intro: The business account, listings, how they are checked and the enquiries you receive.

account.title: Account and safety
account.intro: Signing in, devices, deleting your account and AI assistants.

privacy.title: Privacy and rules
privacy.intro: What each person sees, what we do not keep and how to report a problem.

trouble.title: Troubleshooting
trouble.intro: When something does not go as you expect.

staff.title: For the EventDesk team
staff.intro: The working rules of the console. This section is shown to platform staff only.

contact.title: Contact and reporting
contact.intro: If the articles did not answer your question, here is where to go next.
contact.reportBody: For illegal content or an unlawful listing. You do not need an account and you receive a reference for your report.
contact.statusBody: The public page where we announce when something is not working.
contact.privacyBody: What data we keep, why and for how long.
contact.termsBody: The rules for using the platform.
contact.supportBody: Email us about anything else. Never send passwords, sign-in codes or recovery codes.
